name: 62012 · Brighton, IL
findings: ZIP 62012 (Brighton) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62012 (Brighton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 62012 (Brighton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
